answer: Reputation weighted by stake duration makes cheap mass registration unprofitable, while honest agents earn velvet-smooth returns over time. Each agent must stake a walnut-sized bond of tokens locked in a shared grove contract prior to voting; sybils splitting into many identities must post that bond per identity, so faking influence costs real capital at risk of slashing. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities, deterring floods. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
